description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class provides RESTful API endpoints for managing Customer entities, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers. It incorporates Swagger annotations for API documentation and utilizes various traits, models, validators, and services to handle business logic and validation.

classes.name: CustomerAPI
classes.description: The CustomerAPI class provides REST API endpoints for managing Customer entities in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It supports listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting customers, including validation rules and Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete one or multiple customers by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a customer by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne endpoint.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update endpoint.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Generates validation rules for the request body when creating or updating a customer.

methods.name: getNameCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an entity unique property option for validating customer name uniqueness.

methods.name: setParamsToCustomer
methods.description: Sets the name and description parameters from the request to the Customer entity.
